items.title: ‘It reminded me of the Bhotekoshi floods’: Gorkha residents recount escape
items.summary: A flash flood in the Budhi Gandaki swept away houses and bridges early Sunday, forcing residents of Chumnubri and Dharche to flee to higher ground in the dark. Five people are missing, and six have been rescued by air.

items.title: Bailey bridge restores road link between Rasuwa and Nuwakot after six weeks
items.summary: A 73-metre bridge over the Phalakhu river has reopened the route between the two districts, whose road connection was severed by floods in August.

items.title: Landslide may have triggered flash flooding in Budhi Gandaki, officials say
items.summary: A landslide in Chumchet may have blocked a tributary before water surged downstream. Authorities warn of high flood risks along the Trishuli river as far as Chitwan and Nawalparasi.
